name: GhostHoverCardContent
description: Positioned floating hover-card surface with role="dialog". After logical close it stays mounted with data-state="closed", inert, and pointer-events: none only while its own CSS exit transition or animation runs (useGhostPresence), then unmounts; focus, dismissal, release immediately.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the card surface.

props.name: flip
props.description: Flip to an opposite side when overflowing the viewport or boundary.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance or axis offsets passed to `useFloating`.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement relative to the trigger.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport content through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

props.name: shift
props.description: Shift along the cross axis to keep the card in view.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Mounted card element while open or exiting; null once unmounted.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while mounted and open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on data-state while the surface plays its exit motion after logical close; the surface is also inert with inline pointer-events: none until it unmounts.

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the hover card via useDismissableLayer.

spec.evidence: Approved for minimal `GhostHoverCard` (GHO-100). Visual baselines use `pnpm test:visual:docker`.
